papers.title: Preheat effect on titanium plate fabricated by sputter-free selective laser melting in vacuum
papers.first_author_affiliation: Joining and Welding Research Institute, Osaka University, 11-1 Mihogaoka, Ibaraki, Osaka, 567-0047, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Yuji Sato
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Joining and Welding Research Institute, Osaka University, 11-1 Mihogaoka, Ibaraki, Osaka, 567-0047, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛板的选区激光熔化工艺，但与用户方向的生物医学植入物、多孔结构及应力屏蔽等核心问题关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure design, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration data; it is a process-parameter study for titanium SLM without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究预热对真空选区激光熔化钛板成形质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 设置不同预热温度进行SLM实验，通过显微观察和力学测试表征。
summary_zh.result: 预热温度显著影响钛板的微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过金相和力学测试验证工艺效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of preheating on the fabrication quality of titanium plates produced by sputter-free selective laser melting in vacuum.
summary_en.method: Titanium plates were fabricated by SLM under various preheating temperatures and characterized by microscopy and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Preheating temperature significantly influenced the microstructure and mechanical properties of the as-built titanium plates.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural observation and mechanical tests such as tensile or hardness measurements.
